title: ToolCall
description:
A tool call requested by the model.

Wire format is the OpenAI function-calling shape: `{"id": "...", "type": "function", "function": {"name": "...", "arguments": "<json string>"}}`. The `arguments` field is exposed as a parsed [`Value`]; serialization re-encodes it to the string form the API expects.

id.description: Provider-assigned call id (echoed back in the tool-result message).
